text_blocks.snippet: The Ganges (Ganga) is the longest river entirely within India, measuring 2,525 kilometers (1,569 miles).

list.snippet: Source: Gangotri Glacier in Uttarakhand, India
Mouth: Bay of Bengal (via the Sundarbans delta)
Major Cities: Varanasi, Haridwar, Prayagraj (Allahabad), and Patna
Second Longest: The Godavari River at 1,465 kilometers is the second longest in India and the longest in peninsular India.

Note on Transboundary Rivers: While the Indus (3,180 km) and Brahmaputra (2,900 km) are longer in total length, most of their flow is outside India, making the Ganga the longest river with the majority of its path inside the country.
